    The covering ℤΔ → Q of a periodic component #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 1 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): "Define π(p, j) = τ^{-j}(end p). ... At the root the children give all outgoing arrows. At a nonroot path ending in a, the children give all outgoing arrows except σ^{-1} a; the repetition edge towards the parent gives that arrow. Thus π is bijective on outgoing stars, and mates give the same conclusion on incoming stars."

    In height coordinates the vertex (p, t) of ℤΔ has t = 2j + |p|, and π(p, t) = τ^{-j}(end p).
